articles.summary: ZUG, Switzerland, March 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“ Lithium Argentina ” or the “ Company ”) ( TSX: LAR) ( NYSE: LAR) announced today an updated mineral resource and reserve estimate (“ Updated Estimate ”) on the Cauchari-Olaroz brine operation (“ Cauchari-Olaroz ”) in Jujuy
articles.title: Lithium Argentina Expands Cauchari-Olaroz Resource Estimate; Supports Stage 2 Development Plan

articles.summary: ZUG, Switzerland, March 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“ Lithium Argentina ” or the “ Company ”) ( TSX: LAR) ( NYSE: LAR) will release its fourth quarter and full year 2025 earnings results before market open on Monday, March 23, 2026.
articles.title: Lithium Argentina to Release Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results on March 23, 2026

articles.summary: ZUG, Switzerland, March 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“ Lithium Argentina ” or the “ Company ”) ( TSX: LAR) ( NYSE: LAR) today announced its fourth quarter and full year 2025 results.
